# AgentIO

Kind: component · Defined in [`src/logic/agents/agent_io.h`](../../../src/logic/agents/agent_io.h) · Described in `data/agents_humanbot.json`

An agent as the training host sees it: behaviour, actions in, observations, sensors, reward, done and stats out.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `behavior` | `std::string` | Behaviour name (one brain per behaviour). |
| `observation_size` | `int` | Floats of the vector observation. |
| `action_size` | `int` | Continuous actions. |
| `sensor_name` | `std::string` | Name of the vector sensor sent to the trainer (VectorSensor_size<n>, or the walker's stacking sensor). |
| `branches` | `std::vector<int>` | Sizes of the discrete action branches. |
| `action` | `std::vector<float>` | Host to world: the decision of the coming window (zeros when none). |
| `discrete` | `std::vector<int>` | Host to world: one choice per branch. |
| `reset_requested` | `bool` | Host to world: start a new episode at the next Observe phase (RESET). |
| `observation` | `std::vector<float>` | World to host, written at the Observe phase. |
| `sensors` | `std::vector<AgentSensor>` | Further observations (vectors, or buffers of rows with a count), sent after the vector one. |
| `reward` | `float` | Reward of the window that ended (since the last decision for a component). |
| `done` | `bool` | The episode ended with this observation. |
| `truncated` | `bool` | ... by a limit (time, bounds), not a terminal state. |
| `recordable` | `bool` | false: the observation belongs to no episode (a demo's warm-up), recorders skip it. |
| `stats` | `std::vector<AgentStat>` | This window's stats (key, value, aggregation 0 average / 1 recent / 2 sum / 3 histogram), averaged over agents by the host. |
| `requested` | `bool` | Components only: the agent asks for a decision with this observation; cleared by the host when it sends it. |
| `id` | `int` | Given by the host, unique in the run; kept by an entity over its episodes. |

## Notes

Two uses: the one agent of a world as a world context variable (agentIO(reg) creates it; HumanBot, sphere roller, animal walkers), or a component on every agent entity (sandbox, pursuit), next to the AgentsReset context flag. configure(), addBranch(), addVector(), addBuffer() set it up. Read and written by the training host (src/train/worlds_env.cpp, train_host.cpp) and the policies of src/onnx/ between decision windows.

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AgentFactory](../systems/AgentFactory.md)**
  - Reads resources/<body> and resources/<params> and hashes them (SHA-256); throws AssetError on a malformed file.
  - Creates 16 Jolt bodies and, for a dynamic walker, 15 swing-twist constraints with motors; removes them at finish.
  - Moves the static Ground bodies at every episode start (slope) and sets the segments' poses, velocities and mass properties.
  - Creates the drawn shape entities when draw is set; they live as long as the world.
  - Logs errors without a HumanBotSpawn entity or with WalkRoutes but no ground field, a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.
- **[AnimalAgentView](../systems/AnimalAgentView.md)**
  - Loads the animal library index (preinit) and the viewed species (first tick) from disk on the main thread; logs which.
  - With "log", opens the file once (truncated) and appends a CSV line every frame, flushed.
  - ImGui window "Animal".
  - Creates host entities (one skin per world with a built bot, 800 tiles with marks) that are never destroyed (no finish).
- **[AnimalDrive](../systems/AnimalDrive.md)**
  - Sets motor settings, states, friction and targets of the ragdoll's Jolt constraints.
- **[AnimalEpisode](../systems/AnimalEpisode.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[AnimalFactory](../systems/AnimalFactory.md)**
  - Reads the body file, the params file and the ranges file (params and ranges hashed with SHA-256); throws AssetError when one is missing.
  - Creates the ragdoll's Jolt bodies and constraints; destroys them in finish.
  - Creates one entity per segment shape when draw is set.
  - Logs an error without an AnimalSpawn, a warning when a routed reset finds no spawn point in the slope band.
- **[AnimalObservation](../systems/AnimalObservation.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[AnimalRewards](../systems/AnimalRewards.md)**
  - Teleports the ragdoll's Jolt bodies on a reset.
  - Logs a warning when a routed reset finds no spawn point in the slope band.
- **[DriveTargets](../systems/DriveTargets.md)**
  - Changes the motor settings and targets of the walker's 15 Jolt SwingTwistConstraints.
- **[Episode](../systems/Episode.md)**
  - Parking skips PhysicsStep and the every-tick systems of the world for one decision window.
- **[GaitRoutes](../systems/GaitRoutes.md)**
  - Destroys the old legs' IK chain and target entities at each new route (the arms' ones, if any, are left behind).
  - Logs a warning when no route in the slope band is found.
- **[ModelWatcher](../systems/ModelWatcher.md)**
  - Reads the file system: lists <dir> (or the directories matching a '*' component) for <behavior>-<step>.onnx every `poll` seconds of wall clock; a new checkpoint is loaded once two polls see the same size and write time.
  - Creates ONNX Runtime sessions (PolicyRunner, or AgentPolicy through a process-wide cache keyed by path and write time).
  - Logs info on every load, a warning when a folder has no checkpoint, an error when a model is refused.
- **[Observation](../systems/Observation.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[Policies](../systems/Policies.md)**
  - Looks up <models>/<behavior>.onnx, else the largest step of <models>/<behavior>/<behavior>-<step>.onnx, once per behaviour.
  - ONNX Runtime sessions shared by every world of the process (static cache under a mutex, keyed by canonical path and write time).
  - Logs info per behaviour loaded, debug when a behaviour has no model, error when a model is refused (the behaviour is then left to others).
- **[Policy](../systems/Policy.md)**
  - ONNX Runtime inference on the CPU, on the worker that steps the world.
  - Logs an error and drops the AgentPolicy when its layout does not match the agent.
- **[Pursuit](../systems/Pursuit.md)**
  - Entity creation and destruction: every runner's end destroys its entity and creates a new one (a new agent id).
- **[PursuitObserve](../systems/PursuitObserve.md)**
  - On a trainer RESET every dot entity is destroyed and new ones are created.
- **[Rewards](../systems/Rewards.md)**
  - At a reset: the walker's and the Ground boxes' Jolt bodies are moved and mass properties changed; logs a warning when no spawn point is found in the slope band.
- **[Sandbox](../systems/Sandbox.md)**
  - Reads resources/agents/params/life.params.json (or `life`), resources/agents/params/animal.params.json, the generated bodies resources/animals/bodies/<id>.body.json and resources/agents/rewards/<id>.rewards.json (hashes kept); throws std::runtime_error on a missing life file, an unknown species or a weapon segment the body lacks.
  - Builds a Jolt ragdoll per animal (bodies and constraints in the animal collision layer, group = its ragdoll group), destroys it when the animal leaves or grows; four static wall boxes round the arena.
  - Installs SandboxSys::Contacts as the PhysicsSystem's contact listener: it records the estimated impulse of every contact between two ragdolls (from Jolt's threads, under a mutex) for SandboxLife.
  - Creates and destroys entities: animals, minds, drawn shapes and grass tiles.
  - Logs one debug line per species at init (count, bodies, standing muzzle height, reward terms and round).
- **[SandboxHeuristic](../systems/SandboxHeuristic.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[SandboxObserve](../systems/SandboxObserve.md)**
  - On a RESET: every animal and its ragdoll destroyed and the population drawn again (entities and Jolt bodies created and destroyed).
- **[SphereControl](../systems/SphereControl.md)**
  - Adds a torque to the sphere's Jolt body every tick the held torque is not zero.
  - At a reset teleports the Jolt body and builds the marching cubes colliders around the spawn point synchronously.
  - Logs an error in init when the world does not hold exactly one SphereAgent + Transform + RigidBody entity.
- **[SphereHeuristic](../systems/SphereHeuristic.md)**: none beyond its components.
- **[SphereObserve](../systems/SphereObserve.md)**
  - Three downward ray casts against the world's static bodies per window.
  - At a trainer RESET, teleports the Jolt body and builds the spawn column's colliders.
- **[SphereView](../systems/SphereView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Sphere roller"; collapses "Dynamical", "Worlds" and "Frame time" on first use.
  - Five host entities for the markers, destroyed in finish.
- **[TrainHost](../systems/service-TrainHost.md)**
  - gRPC client of the ML-Agents trainer (MlAgentsClient on localhost:<port>); reads the environment parameters and engine configuration side channels.
  - Files: envparams.txt (-envParamsOut, written on change), .demo (record-demo), eval summaries (var.out), replays (<prefix>.track.*, .replay.*, .sandbox.*, .grass.bin), legs CSV, cot_out, demo checks JSON.
  - tf::Executor workers for bench, eval and the worlds' steps.
  - Restarts the worlds with the trainer's seed (ScenarioRunner::restart) when the trainer connects in mode=train.
  - Logs the mode's progress and summaries; exit codes 0 (QUIT, stop signal), 1 (bad arguments), 2 (connection lost).
- **[WalkerView](../systems/WalkerView.md)**
  - ImGui window "Walker" (tick, decisions, target speed, speed, head height, reward, slope).
- **[WorldsEnvironment](../systems/service-WorldsEnvironment.md)**
  - Owns a tf::Executor of `threads` named workers (threads > 1) that steps the worlds in parallel (ScenarioRunner::step).
  - On RESET runs every world's Observe phase alone (SystemSet::fixed_observe_only).
  - Writes the ML-Agents protobuf output: AgentInfos per behaviour, brain parameters with a behaviour's first agents, averaged stats in the stats side channel.
